title: Role Salary Contribution Ratio
scenario: Calculate the ratio of a specific role's total salary to the total project budget. Return 'project_id', 'role', and 'contribution_ratio'.
tableSchema: projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT), employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT)
hint: SUM(salary) per role per project divided by project budget.
correctQuery: SELECT e.project_id, e.role, SUM(e.salary)::NUMERIC / p.budget AS contribution_ratio FROM employees e JOIN projects p ON e.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY e.project_id, e.role, p.budget;
